join.relationship: many facilities to one GPM pixel; one GPM pixel to one record per month

facility_id.description: Stable facility identifier; preserve as string.

facility_name.description: Facility name from supplied power-facility database.

gpm_pixel_key.description: GPM grid-cell identifier used to link facility to rainfall.

year.description: Calendar year of monthly rainfall record.

precipitation_mean_rate_mm_hr.description: Mean precipitation rate for the GPM grid cell and month.

estimated_monthly_accumulation_mm.description: Monthly accumulation estimated from monthly mean rate.

quality_index.description: Source-provided GPM quality index; retain as supplied, do not interpret as a probability.

mapped_facility_count.description: Number of facilities in the supplied facility mapping that use this GPM pixel.

facility_linkage_status.description: Whether this GPM grid-month row is linked to at least one supplied facility.

interpretation_notes: Use rainfall accumulation in mm/month for monthly comparisons.
Do not sum rainfall values across facilities sharing a pixel; those values are repeated estimates, not independent rainfall measurements.
For regional summaries, aggregate unique GPM pixels rather than facility-expanded rows to avoid overweighting grid cells containing many facilities.
The provided GPM dataset covers 2022-01 through 2025-09 (45 months).
